sidebar.note: Sessions live in an HttpOnly cookie. Nothing is stored in the browser.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Authenticate with a local account to reach the control plane.
login.missing: The username and the password are required.
login.hint: The session lives in an HttpOnly cookie; the password is never stored in the browser.

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: The state of this node, the runtimes it offers and the work in flight.
overview.runtimesHint: The backends that may provision an instance on this node.
overview.resourcesHint: The capacity that is left for the instances of the node.
overview.noHostData: The node did not report the capacity of the host.
overview.instancesNote: Workstations that are alive right now.
overview.jobsNote: Requests the control plane has scheduled.
overview.recentJobsHint: The last eight requests of this node.
overview.noJobs: No job has run on this node yet.

instances.title: Instances
instances.subtitle: Every workstation of the node, its state and the time it has left.
instances.formHint: The template decides the runtime, the image and the resources.
instances.empty: No instance is running on this node.
instances.tableHint: The countdown follows the deadline of the instance.
instances.consoleUnavailable: The node did not return a console endpoint.
instances.stopConfirm: Stop the instance {id}? The workload is asked to finish first.
instances.destroyConfirm: Destroy the instance {id} and release its resources? The result is not recoverable.

form.versionHint: Leave empty to use the highest published version.
form.name: Name
form.ttlHint: Leave empty to use the default lifetime of the node.
form.envHint: A JSON object of string values, for example {"CI": "1"}.
form.envInvalid: The environment has to be a JSON object of string values.
form.secretsHint: Comma separated names of the secrets the instance may read.
form.idempotencyHint: A repeated key returns the same instance instead of creating a second one.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.subtitle: Every request the control plane has scheduled, with its outcome.
jobs.tableHint: A job that has not finished yet can still be canceled.
jobs.empty: No job has run on this node yet.
jobs.cancelConfirm: Cancel the job {id}? The work in flight is interrupted.

artifacts.title: Artifacts
artifacts.subtitle: The files the workloads produced, with their digest and their retention.
artifacts.tableHint: A download is authenticated: the link is never a capability.

templates.title: Templates
templates.subtitle: The environments this node can provision, with the resources they ask for.
templates.empty: The catalogue of this node is empty.
templates.noDescription: The template does not carry a description.
templates.prefill: The instance form was prefilled with {template}.
templates.detailHint: The published version of the template, with its digest.

exec.title: Run a command
exec.subtitle: The command runs inside {instance}.
exec.commandHint: Every argument is separate. The command is never handed to a shell.
exec.cwdHint: Leave empty to use the default directory of the instance.
exec.timeoutHint: The node stops the command when the deadline is reached.
exec.truncated: The output was truncated by the node.

admin.title: Administration
admin.subtitle: The accounts, the client credentials and the audit trail of the node.
admin.usersHint: The accounts that may use this node.
admin.noUsers: The node has no account yet.
admin.passwordHint: The password is hashed by the node and is never sent back.
admin.missingFields: The username and the password are required.
admin.keysHint: Bearer credentials for the REST API and the MCP bridge.
admin.keyScopesHint: Comma separated scopes, for example instances:read,instances:create.
admin.keySecret: The secret of the new credential
admin.keySecretWarning: This secret is shown exactly once. Copy it now — the node keeps only its hash and cannot show it again.
admin.auditHint: Every security relevant decision of the node.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.network: The control plane did not answer. Check that the daemon is running.
errors.permission_denied: The request is not allowed for this account.
errors.quota_exceeded: The node or the account reached a limit.
errors.capability_unavailable: The node cannot serve this request right now.
errors.job_timeout: The operation did not finish in time.
errors.artifact_expired: The artifact is no longer available.
errors.human_action_required: An operator has to act before the request can continue.
errors.invalid_request: The request was rejected as invalid.
errors.conflict: The request conflicts with the current state.
errors.internal_error: The node failed for an unexpected reason.
